actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .mmBite0000000000]] attack and uses [[/item .mmConstrict00000]].

actions.name: constrict
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=IgOMjRxAt7UISkJq]], one [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=IgOMjRxAt7UISkJq]] [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=IgOMjRxAt7UISkJq]] the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=IgOMjRxAt7UISkJq]] [[lookup @range.units activity=IgOMjRxAt7UISkJq]]. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. The target has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]), and it has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until the grapple ends.

actions.name: swallow
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=YorssyWMumAsvzx3]], [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=YorssyWMumAsvzx3]] by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} (the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can have only one creature swallowed at a time). Failure: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} swallows the target, which is no longer &Reference[Grappled apply=false]. While swallowed, a creature has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] and &Reference[Restrained apply=false] conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, and takes [[/damage average activity=zrWNjO9mkbN28spL]] damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save format=long activity=rGeGukkm2t2fXsoy]] at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls in a space within [[lookup @range.value activity=rGeGukkm2t2fXsoy]] [[lookup @range.units activity=rGeGukkm2t2fXsoy]]. of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]]-foot-long, [[lookup @target.template.width activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]]-foot-wide [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]]. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.
